description: Source code for the xdiff library implementing diff algorithms, including Myers' algorithm, with functions for computing differences, managing change groups, and scoring split positions.

classes.name: xdpsplit_t
classes.description: Structure representing a split point in the Myers' diff algorithm.

classes.name: xdlgroup
classes.description: Structure representing a group of changed lines for diff output.

classes.name: split_measurement
classes.description: Holds measurements about a hypothetical split position for scoring.

classes.name: split_score
classes.description: Represents the score of a split position based on heuristics.

methods.name: xdl_split
methods.description: Performs the Myers' algorithm split to find the furthest reach point.

methods.name: xdl_recs_cmp
methods.description: Recursively compares two file segments to identify differences.

methods.name: xdl_do_diff
methods.description: Main function to compute the diff between two files using Myers' algorithm.

methods.name: xdl_add_change
methods.description: Creates a new change record and adds it to the change list.

methods.name: recs_match
methods.description: Checks if two records are identical based on minimal perfect hash.

methods.name: get_indent
methods.description: Calculates indentation level of a line, treating tabs as 8 spaces.

methods.name: measure_split
methods.description: Measures characteristics of a hypothetical split position for scoring.

methods.name: score_add_split
methods.description: Calculates a heuristic score for a split position based on indentation and blank lines.

methods.name: score_cmp
methods.description: Compares two split scores to determine which is better.

methods.name: xdl_build_script
methods.description: Builds an edit script from the computed differences.

methods.name: xdl_change_compact
methods.description: Optimizes change groups by sliding them for better diff presentation.

methods.name: xdl_free_script
methods.description: Frees the memory allocated for a change script.

methods.name: xdl_call_hunk_func
methods.description: Calls the user-defined function for each diff hunk.

methods.name: xdl_mark_ignorable_lines
methods.description: Marks lines as ignorable based on blank lines.

methods.name: record_matches_regex
methods.description: Checks if a record matches any ignore regex.

methods.name: xdl_mark_ignorable_regex
methods.description: Marks lines as ignorable based on regex patterns.

methods.name: xdl_diff
methods.description: High-level function to perform diff between two files, including diff calculation, change grouping, and output.
